question: Find CI on ₹1000 for 3 years at 10% p.a.?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive rate for 3 years at 10% = 33.1%

Total Compound Interest = Principal × Effective Rate

CI = 1000 × 33.1%

CI = 1000 × (33.1 ÷ 100) = 331

**∴ Answer = ₹331**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1000, Rate (R) = 10% p.a., Time (n) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

Compound Interest (CI) = A − P
